name: Acrobatic Hop
body:
You gain an advantageous position even when no ground remains.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You may make a 5-foot step into a square 5 feet above you, provided that space is unoccupied. You must succeed on a DC 20 Acrobatics check to do so. Failure indicates you move to the space beneath the desired space. On a success, you may perform your actions from the elevated space, falling at the end of your turn if not supported in some way.
